name: Correlation
description: Pairwise correlation of two or more numeric columns, in long format (one row per pair) or as a matrix. Pearson and Spearman use SQL sufficient statistics (count, sums, squares and cross products; Spearman ranks with SQL windows), so they handle any row count with O(columns^2) memory. Kendall tau-b is computed in Java and supports at most 100000 rows unless sample_rows draws a deterministic reservoir sample. Optional partial correlation on control columns via the inverse of the moment-based correlation matrix. Long output carries the sample size, the p-value (t approximation for Pearson/Spearman, normal z approximation for Kendall), a confidence interval (Fisher's z for Pearson/Spearman, asymptotic standard error for Kendall) and p_adjusted with the requested multiple-comparison correction across all pairs. The matrix format has no p-values, so correction is not applied there.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: At least two distinct numeric columns; every unordered pair is emitted.

method.title: Method
method.description: pearson correlates raw values, spearman correlates ranks with ties sharing a rank, kendall computes tau-b with the usual tie correction.

partial.title: Control columns
partial.description: Optional numeric columns partialled out: correlation is computed from the inverse of the correlation matrix of the pair plus these controls.

output.title: Output
output.description: long returns one row per pair with n, p_value and confidence interval; matrix returns one row per variable with a column per variable.

alpha.title: Significance level
alpha.description: Confidence level of the interval: 1 - alpha. Must be in (0, 1).

sample_rows.title: Sample rows
sample_rows.description: 0 uses every eligible row (no cap for Pearson/Spearman); a positive N fits on a deterministic reservoir sample of N rows (DuckDB USING SAMPLE reservoir(N ROWS) REPEATABLE(seed)), which also lets Kendall stay within its in-memory limit.

seed.title: Sampling seed
seed.description: Seed for the repeatable reservoir sample; the same input and seed give the same result. Ignored when sample_rows is 0. Must be 0 or positive.

correction.title: Multiple comparison correction
correction.description: Adjustment applied to the p_values of all emitted pairs in long format: none copies p_value, bonferroni and holm use the same step-down methods as dap.hypothesis_test, bh is the Benjamini-Hochberg FDR method. The matrix format carries no p-values and is never adjusted.
